verdict.rationale: stagewise is a desktop agentic IDE, and such a product could plausibly expose a public API, so the story applies. The evidence never documents one: the API references concern bringing your own model-provider keys (BYOK) and custom inference endpoints, which are inbound model configuration rather than an API for driving stagewise itself. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
